name: Master's Tome Of Specialization (8-20) unlocks the next unknown slot in order (#4827)
contract: Item 97332 requires spell 979987 (specialization slot VII, SPECIALIZATION_SWAP_SPELLS[6]) and casts dummy learner spell 92982 (Learning) on use, charges -1. Spell 92982 is a bare SPELL_EFFECT_LEARN_SPELL with TriggerSpell 0, so Spell::EffectLearnSpell taught nothing and the tome never advanced a character past slot VII. spell_ascension_masters_tome_specialization now binds to 92982 and learns the first unknown spell among SPECIALIZATION_SWAP_SPELLS[7..19] (slots VIII-XX, 979988 first), consuming one tome per use. OnPlayerCanUseItem refuses a further use once slots 8-20 are all known, the way the native Tomes already refuse once their own slot is unlocked. A character without slot VII is refused by the item's own RequiredSpell gate before the script runs (already working, unrelated to this fix) and keeps its tome and its unknown slot.

steps.label: First use learns the first unknown slot, VIII
It does not skip ahead to slot IX
Second use learns the next unknown slot, IX
It does not skip ahead to slot X
Without slot VII the tome is refused and kept
Nothing is learned without slot VII
